categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: environmental investigation and appraisal, environmental research, consulting and design, environmental system integration, and third-party environmental pollution treatment. These segments cover the full lifecycle of environmental technology services from consulting and planning to construction and operation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced environmental science and technology, including AI for biodiversity protection, environmental DNA monitoring, distributed fiber optic sensing for water pollution tracing, and VOCs pollution control technologies. It integrates patented technologies and proprietary equipment in system integration and pollution control, emphasizing technology-driven, precise, and economical solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include local government departments, industrial parks, and various industrial enterprises. The company serves ecological environment, housing, water conservancy, agriculture, and natural resource sectors, focusing on pollution control, ecological protection, and green development projects primarily in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in Jiangsu Province and the Yangtze River Delta region, with business expanding to Guangdong, Tibet, and six other provinces. Its headquarters is in Nanjing, China, with subsidiaries in Shanghai, Nantong, and other cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream environmental service provider, offering comprehensive environmental technology services, consulting, system integration, and third-party pollution treatment. It acts as a technology and service integrator rather than a raw material supplier or end-product manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing environmental service capabilities, advancing green low-carbon technologies, and integrating AI and big data for environmental monitoring and management. R&D focuses on VOCs treatment, low-carbon wastewater treatment, digital twin technology for organic waste gas equipment, and smart environmental solutions, supported by strong collaboration with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through project-based service contracts including environmental investigation, consulting, system integration, and pollution treatment services. The company also earns from technology licensing, equipment sales, and government subsidies related to environmental projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading environmental technology service provider in Jiangsu and the Yangtze River Delta, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and comprehensive service offerings. It faces competition from large state-owned enterprises and private environmental firms but maintains competitive advantages through technology innovation and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 834 million, an 11.36% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 167 million, up 8.33%. Total assets reached RMB 2 billion, growing 13.65% year-over-year. The company shows steady growth with increasing R&D investment and expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering scientifically precise, practical, and cost-effective environmental solutions through technology empowerment. Its unique value lies in integrating advanced environmental science, patented technologies, and full lifecycle services to meet complex environmental challenges, supported by a strong talent pool and academic partnerships.
